none: PAS SWYOR-200652: Early Medieval coin; penny of Cuthred
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An early medieval silver penny of Cuthred, King of Kent (798-807), Canterbury mint, moneyer Werheard. It is 18.9mm in diameter and 0.9mm thick. It weighs 1.35gm. Reference: North, volume 1, number 211. Inscription: + CVÐRED REX CANT [Cuthred Rex Cantuariorum, Cuthred King of the Kentish]. Inscription: + VERHEARD MONETA [Werheard the Moneyer or Coin of Werheard]
